title: renderContractHistory
responsibility: Formats semantic contract changes and attributed commit history as grouped, wrapped terminal text with optional color and summary-only field suppression.

inputs.name: renderContractDiff.diff
inputs.description: Structured semantic diff with complete filtered counts and possibly limited contract rows; ignored file counts and snapshot labels are preserved.

inputs.name: renderContractDiff.summary
inputs.description: When true, prints per-contract and change-kind counts without field values; defaults to false.

inputs.name: renderContractLog.log
inputs.description: Attributed first-parent material-change records, including identity-following scope and an explicit indication of unscanned candidate history.

inputs.name: renderContractLog.summary
inputs.description: When true, prints per-contract and change-kind counts without field values; defaults to false.

inputs.name: renderContractHistoryJson.result
inputs.description: Structured diff or committed log result to serialize; summary output omits field values while retaining contract metadata and field-kind counts.

inputs.name: renderContractHistoryJson.summary
inputs.description: When true, prints per-contract and change-kind counts without field values; defaults to false.

outputs.name: renderContractDiff
outputs.description: Grouped terminal text containing snapshot labels, complete summary counts, per-contract status and optionally wrapped old-to-new field values.

outputs.name: renderContractLog
outputs.description: Attributed commit blocks with per-contract field changes or summaries, identity-following limits and a truncation notice where candidates remain unscanned.

outputs.name: renderContractHistoryJson
outputs.description: Structured JSON preserving full semantic field values by default, or per-contract metadata and field-kind counts without values when summary is true.
